'''Pammant''' was a [[planet]] [[Colonist|colonized]] by members of the [[Quarren]] [[species]]. By the [[Republic Era]], several Quarren [[engineer]]s resided there. At Pammant, the Quarren formed both [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]] and [[Pammant Docks]] shipbuilding corporations and [[Factory|factories]] that belonged to the former. By [[22 BBY]], the planet was brought under the affiliation of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and served as the place of construction of new [[starship]] classes, including the [[Providence-class Dreadnought|''Providence''-class Dreadnought]] and [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]]. During the [[Clone Wars]], Pammant and its factories continued to build ships in order to give the Confederacy an acceptable [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|armada]].

==Description==
The planet Pammant<ref name="Republic" /> was located in the [[Calamari sector]]'s [[Pammant system]], which was within the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Appendix" /> and [[the Slice]],<ref name="TheSlice" /> situated in grid square U-6 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="Appendix" /> The planet shared its name with the [[Pammant Prowler-250]], a type of [[fishing]] [[Boat|vessel]] produced by [[United Dac Engineering Corps]].<ref name="SVNew">[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles (second edition)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles'', second edition]]</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Lucid Voice was built by the Quarren Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps—much to the displeasure of the Mon Cals who share their planet with the Quarren. We're checking to see if QFD and their erstwhile partners, Pammant Docks, might have supervised the reassembly.|An [[Unidentified Imperial technician (Sentinel Base)|Imperial technician]], to [[Wilhuff Tarkin]]|<ref name="Tarkin" />}}
At some point, members of the [[Quarren]] [[species]] [[Colonist|colonized]] Pammant.<ref name="">{{ShipsandVehiclesCite|56|History of the Ship}}</ref> In the [[Republic Era|days]] of the [[Galactic Republic]], a number of Quarren [[engineer]]s resided<ref name="Tarkin" /> on the colony world.<ref name="Republic" /> By [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Date32">{{EncyclopediaCite|Republic and Separatist Ships (1)}} establishes that [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]] and [[Providence-class Dreadnought|''Providence''-class Dreadnoughts]] were active following the [[Invasion of Naboo]], dated to [[32 BBY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''.</ref> the engineers established<ref name="Republic">{{EncyclopediaCite|Republic and Separatist Ships (1)}}</ref> both the Quarren [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]] (QFD)<ref name="Tarkin" /> and [[Shipyard|shipbuilding facilities]] that were to be used by the company,<ref name="Republic" /> while others formed a second corporation<ref name="Tarkin" /> at the planet,<ref name="Republic" /> the [[Pammant Docks]], creating a partnership between the two.<ref name="Tarkin" /> Around 32 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]],<ref name="Date32" /> following an unsuccessful [[Invasion of Naboo|invasion]] of<ref name="Republic" /> the planet<ref name="Tarkin" /> [[Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation]], the Quarren shipwrights designed and constructed the [[Providence-class Dreadnought|''Providence''-class Dreadnought]] at the Federation's request, introducing the new class with the ''[[Invisible Hand]]'' as [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray]]'s [[flagship]].<ref name="Republic" />

[[File:ProvidenceClassDreadnought-SWM42.png|thumb|left|300px|Pammant was the birthplace of the ''Providence''-class Dreadnought (pictured).]]
[[Standard year|Years]] later, Pammant was brought under the banner of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] after both QFD and Pammant Docks allied themselves with the government.<ref name="Tarkin" /> With the initial [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|Separatist armada]] organized from heavily armed [[bulk transport]]s of allied corporations,<ref name="Rise">''[[Rise of the Separatists]]''</ref> the two shipbuilding companies<ref name="Republic" /> and other allies worked to create an acceptable [[Navy|naval]] force. With their Quarren allies, the Separatists were able to quickly produce large numbers of [[capital ship]]s crewed by [[B1-series battle droid]]s and stocked with various [[starfighter]]s,<ref name="Rise" /> including additional units of the ''Providence''-class constructed at Pammant's facilities.<ref name="Republic" /> After the [[Clone Wars]] [[First Battle of Geonosis|broke out]] in [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the [[First Battle of Geonosis|beginning]] of the [[Clone Wars]] and the conflict's [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]] to [[22 BBY]]. As {{BuildFalconCite|43|Starship Fact File}} establishes that the ''[[Malevolence]]'' was constructed during the war and destroyed at the Battle of the [[Kaliida Nebula]] as depicted in "[[Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence'']]," the [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser|starship]] must have been built in 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]].</ref> both QFD and Pammant Docks were enlisted to construct another new [[warship]] design, the [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] blueprinted by [[Ruggle Schmong]] for the Separatists. Secretly built at a cavernous dry dock far from Republic [[Spy|spies]], the ''Subjugator''-class ''[[Malevolence]]'' was then deployed<ref name="BMF 43" /> by the Separatists in a multi-[[Standard month|month]] [[Malevolence Campaign|campaign]] against the Republic,<ref name="The Clone Wars">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Clone Wars Begin}}</ref> serving as the class's lead [[starship]] and initial testbed, but the campaign ultimately ended after the ship's [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula|destruction]].<ref name="Collapse">''[[Collapse of the Republic]]''</ref>

By [[14 BBY]],<ref name="TarkinDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']] to [[14 BBY]].</ref> during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], QFD and Pammant Docks no longer maintained a mutual partnership.<ref name="Tarkin" /> That year,<ref name="TarkinDate" /> the Empire's [[Sentinel Base]] in the [[Arkanis sector]] was [[Attack on Sentinel Base|attacked]] by a [[Berch Teller's rebel cell|group of insurgents]] led by Imperial [[Desertion|defector]] [[Berch Teller]] that utilized a [[Berch Teller's warship|downsized version]] of ''Providence''-class Dreadnought as Teller's flagship. The vessel incorporated technologies from the Separatist [[dreadnought]] ''[[Lucid Voice]]'',<ref name="Tarkin" /> built at Pammant<ref name="Providence">{{EncyclopediaCite|Republic and Separatist Ships (1)}} establishes that all [[Providence-class Dreadnought|''Providence''-class Dreadnoughts]], which includes the ''[[Lucid Voice]]'' per [[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']], were built at Pammant.</ref> by QFD. Though the latter ship had been dismantled<ref name="Tarkin" /> [[18 BBY|four years]] prior<ref name="Date18">[[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']], the events of which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[14 BBY]], establishes that the ''[[Lucid Voice]]'' was dismantled four [[Standard year|years]] before its events, and therefore in [[18 BBY]].</ref> at the [[Bilbringi shipyards]], the Empire acted with caution and contacted both Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps and Pammant Docks to find out if the companies had supervised the dreadnought's rebuilding.<ref name="Tarkin" />

==Locations==
Pammant was host to several shipbuilding [[Factory|factories]]<ref name="Republic" /> and at least one large dry dock.<ref name="BMF 43" /> At the factories of Pammant, various starships were constructed<ref name="Republic" /> that were exported<ref name="Beginnings" /> off the planet for organizations such as the Trade Federation and Separatist Alliance.<ref name="Republic" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pammant was first mentioned in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in [[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']], a [[2014]] novel authored by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Tarkin" /> Originally, it was introduced in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity via ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]'', a [[2005]] reference book written by [[Curtis Saxton]].<ref name="Cross-Sections">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> [[Pammant/Legends|Pammant]] later made its first full Legends appearance in the "Card Commander" minigame, a part of<ref name="Card Commander">{{TCWA|Card Commander}}</ref> the [[2010]]<ref name="Season 3 Premiere Announcement">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/season3_date/index.html|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Season 3 Premiere Date Announced}}</ref> [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]<ref name="Card Commander" /> by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment.<ref name="Season 3 Premiere Announcement" />
